name: Snitch
tagline: Focus sessions with money on the line: lose focus and your stake goes to friends.
problem: Students skip work when nothing is at stake.
solution: Timed sessions with a monetary stake; the webcam detects looking away or phone use, a Chrome extension logs distracting sites as strikes, and sessions run from Discord.
demo_moment: Team-described: start a session from Discord, pick up a phone and see a strike.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Uses social and financial stakes rather than blocking.

lessons: Stakes beat restrictions: let friends hold the consequence.
